card.name: Slash in radiation dose units
card.fires_on: The slash between a dose unit (mSv, mGy, Gy) and an activity unit (MBq, GBq) in radiation dosimetry table headers. It also fires on the bracket just before MBq in similar headers.

modes.label: Dose per activity slash
modes.description: The slash in unit pairs like mGy/MBq in absorbed-dose table headings for radiopharmaceuticals.
modes.example: Absorbed Dose per Unit of Activity Administered (mGy<</>>MBq) Organ Adults 15

modes.label: Bracket before MBq
modes.description: The opening bracket before MBq in pediatric activity headings.

card.writes: It pushes toward unit text after the slash, and mostly away from 'rad' forms, in favor of SI units like MBq.
card.plain: It marks the slash in radiation dose units such as mSv/MBq in imaging-agent dosimetry tables.
